profile.headline: Platform / Infrastructure Engineer | IDP | DX | IaC | Tooling
profile.summary:
Platform Engineering / Developer Enablement isn’t just my job. It’s my passion. It’s what I do in my free time. It’s what drives me, and is why the experience in my years speaks louder than my years of experience.

Results-driven platform and infrastructure engineer specializing in enhancing developer productivity, AI enablement, and self-service tooling and automation. I have particularly deep expertise in building scalable internal platforms, automating infrastructure and security compliance, and pioneering robust CI/CD pipeline solutions. I apply Lean Management & Six Sigma principles to eliminate variance in processes spanning from initial onboarding to production deployment. The solutions I architect are designed to mitigate business and security risks, eliminate process variance, and minimize cost through ensuring adherence to best practices by design.

GitHub: https://github.com/tj-smith47
Website: https://jarvispro.io

positions.title: Software Engineer II, Infrastructure
positions.description:
- Built local-development tooling for the team's Jenkins shared library, enabling engineers to test library changes, component modifications, and upgrade compatibility locally before deploying to shared environments, preventing pipeline outages.
- Designed a cascade orchestrator that decomposes monolithic Jenkins pipelines into modular, dependency-aware run sets, isolating failure domains, tightening per-change feedback, and enabling pipeline and module ownership via centralized notification routing.
- Restructured the monolithic CI build image into parallel multi-stage builds, cutting build times, eliminating all critical and high vulnerabilities, and streamlining publishing workflows to improve the developer experience.
- Extended the team's Go IaC CLI: pipeline visualization and decomposition analytics powering historical metrics dashboards; an identity governance system for JIT production access elevation from the terminal; configuration validation with Terragrunt dependency-graph cycle detection.
- Re-architected AI-agent guidance in the primary infrastructure repo around progressive disclosure, splitting a monolithic CLAUDE.md into path-triggered rules and on-demand skills so agents load only the context relevant to the change at hand.
positions.insights: Skills: Go (Programming Language) · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Teragrunt · Jenkins · Microsoft Azure

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer - Engineering Enablement
positions.description:
In addition to my previous responsibilities, as a Senior Software Engineer I have additional accountability in the areas of project management and team leadership, process automation and standardization, and hardening the company’s security posture. I work with engineering leaders to screen, refine, and schedule work targeting continuous improvement of our onboarding process, the overall developer experience (DX), our internal developer portal (IDP), and our continuous integration & continuous delivery (CI/CD) deployment pipeline. Leveraging Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and a Lean Management concept called Poka Yoke, I work to ensure adherence to best practices and security policies by making the right way, the easy way - if not, the only way. I also apply my background in Six Sigma and continuous improvement to mitigate process variance through vigorous documentation and expansion of our automation and tooling suites.

● Leverage background in Lean Six Sigma to eliminate process variance by making the right way, the only way using a technique called Poka Yoke
● Manage company’s GitHub Org using Infrastructure as Code (Terraform)
● Rapidly retrofit our IDP, making key updates to support the needs of contractors during a large cloud migration project with a less than 8 hour turnaround per request.
● Lead a cross-departmental initiative to eliminate Security vulnerabilities in secrets using SOPS
● Plan and scope interdepartmental projects and work assignments
● Coordinate with IT to ensure safe state management of user onboarding and offboarding.

positions.title: Software Engineer, Engineering Enablement
positions.description:
- Author various full-stack services, full-featured CLI tools, scripts, and automations that skyrocket developer productivity.
- Deliver tooling and documentation that supports a streamlined and standardized development experience.
- Pioneered a proprietary shift-left CI/CD process that coordinates batched testing, acting as a gate to production deployment.
- Owner & SME of Salesloft’s internal developer portal.
- Facilitate the QA deployment & testing lifecycle. 
- Maintain the health of Kubernetes environments.
- Maintain our GitHub Enterprise configuration using IaC / Terraform.
- Enable rapid org-wide security compliance and process changes across hundreds of repositories.
- Drive AI tooling engagement initiatives with internal custom agent.

positions.title: Associate Software Engineer, Engineering Enablement
positions.description: Generate / maintain tooling and provide solutions for our engineers between the development and QA stages of the product cycle.

positions.title: IT / IoT Consultant
positions.description: Assist as needed for local IT and IoT endeavors.

positions.title: Electro Mechanical Technician
positions.description:
At Major, I had the opportunity to rebuild our site's entire physical network from the ground up after our company fell victim to a cyber attack. I partnered with our corporate IT regularly to ensure a standardized configuration and device deployment plan was followed, while simultaneously collaborating with the maintenance team to implement machine safety and preventative maintenance automations using IoT edge devices. I am also the site PoC for coordination and implementation of our IT, Engineering, and Maintenance projects and work directly with the primary Project Manager at our parent site in Candiac.

Process Engineering:
- Reconcile shared goals between quality, maintenance, & production to trim redundant process waste.
- Develop tech tools for automated data entry and maintenance scheduling with VBA & Excel.
- Re-program PLC parameters & scripting to optimize process flow and eliminate bottlenecks.
- Drive morale through mediation of shift conflicts, increasing employee engagement & change success.
Network Engineering:
- Partnered with corporate IT to reconfigure local network and domain / GPO after cyber attack.
- Investigate, test, and develop sandboxed data acquisition / logging systems 
- Develop web applications for secure remote management of machines 
- Deploy IoT edge devices to increase safety and lower maintenance costs.
Core IT Competencies:
- Login & access
- Active directory logic group & special features
- File sharing & Logical NAS
- Network level segmentation
- Wifi management / rules of access
- Virtualization
- Backup / restore
- Defense systems & countermeasures
- Barcoding & RFID programmation
- Cameras & access control

positions.title: Area Manager I - Operations
positions.description:
Led shifts of up to 115 associates as a Load Out Area Manager during Peak. Managed and developed a team of 65 direct reports. Translated top-down cost/productivity directives with bottom-up morale/culture implications to deliver results that put safety first. Exhibited extreme ownership of KPI's such as On Time Dispatch (OTD) and Service Level Agreements (SLAs) to ensure Amazon always keeps its' Customer Promise. Established and maintained site's Swag Store inventory and created a performance based automated online banking system, bringing site's connection scores to an all-time high.
Key Accomplishments:
> Voted site's 2020 Manager of Peak Award after 7 weeks in the role.
> Established a best practice that has delivered a 36% Direct Rate improvement and counting.
> Analyzed WTD/WoW KPI's to deliver meaningful root cause analysis of barriers in real time.
> Instilled a safety environment that attacks the process, not the individual.
-> Acted as site POC for Social Distancing, coordinating daily with Region's Program Manager.
-> Coordinated with Ops Manager's to optimize 5S layout via Lean Mgmt principles.
> Utilized support teams such as ACES Tiger Team, Tech Tools Subject Matter Experts (SMEs), and IT to deep dive network-wide barriers in cost and productivity.
-> Reverse engineered Fill/Pick Path files to optimize process flow, reduce bottlenecks, and cut waste.
> Designed and employed tools that enable precise monitoring and execution of team goals.
-> Forms: Cluster Chart, Engagement Matrix, SOPs, SA/PA SW Rotation, QR Staging Flip-book
-> Excel/VBA Tools:
--> Attendance Flow Chart
--> Shift Ops Tool
--> Break Tracker
--> AA Info Converter
--> DWX3 Site Map w/ Fill/Pick Path mapping
-> Macros:
--> Dispatch Wave Planner: restructures staging/dispatch to minimize travel
--> Pick Priority Sheet: identifies and prioritizes routes based on SPR and travel
positions.insights: Skills: VBA Excel · Operating Systems · Employee Engagement · Project Management · Lean Six Sigma · Scripting · Planning Budgeting & Forecasting · Process Automation · Web Applications

positions.title: Mechanic - Project Specialist
positions.description:
Spearhead large scale process and safety improvements through engineering of LEAN operational overhauls to machine and workflow processes. Coordinate needs of departments with management to influence continual best practices, with high consideration for employee responsiveness and collaborative transitions. Consult with affiliated departments and machine operators to determine root cause of problems in order to implement process improvements that permanently fix problems.

Examples of some of my projects Include:

Double Fold Press Automatic Operation & Reliability Overhaul
-Troubleshoot erratic movement of machine
-Determine mechanical, electrical, and pneumatic needs
-Investigate software processes to determine physical alterations for safe operation
-Rebuilt press and restored reliable automatic operation (unreliable for 1.5y)

Extruder Optimization
-Investigated modifications to motor drive parameters to increase production
-Optimized settings to reduce material defects and repairs
-Increased production speed by 35% while operating at lower load, PSI, and temperature

Finishing Department Process/Safety Improvements
-Examples of LEAN upgrades:
  >Implemented stocking system for daily pre-cut materials
  >Engineered Single-Minute Exchange of Dies for 2 machines
  >Design, fabricate, and install articulating safety curtain mechanism
  >Implement startup/safety procedures

Crimping Department Wire Waste Improvement:
-Investigated origin of excessive waste and reduced to 6 specs generating 97% of waste
-Implemented various mechanical and process changes that saved an estimated $84,100 annual

Barcode Scanner System:
-Reduced a project budgeted $12,000 to $600 by insourcing work and materials, saving $11,400
-Reduced timeline of project by creating an internal team to install electrical and IT needs, eliminating the need for contractors.

*The latter two projects occurred simultaneously over 6 months with an estimated savings of $95,500 amid COVID-19 interference.

positions.title: Maintenance Mechanic
positions.description:
Perform preventative and active maintenance on various machines to ensure the safe and expeditious production of Major Wire products, as well as perform structural maintenance to facilitate changing needs and opportunities within our company.

My daily tasks/skills include:
- Installation/modification/inspection/repair and operation of: 
--> Extruders
--> Crimpers
--> Shears & Brake Presses
--> Pneumatic/hydraulic systems, including compressors and hydraulic reservoirs
- Using precision measurement tools to ensure proper specifications are met
- Using diagrams/schematics/manuals to troubleshoot mechanical and electrical systems
- Using/modifying/troubleshooting computer systems and networks:
-->Use of all Microsoft Office Applications
-->Set up linked Microsoft Office Documents to ensure information up-to-date
-->Identify and communicate network/program needs and inconsistencies 
-->Build and optimize computers from Raspberry Pi to Power PC's based on company needs
-->Examine inventory needs and order parts before they are needed
-->Submit daily work logs consistently and responsibly
-->Communicate professionally with headquarters in emergency situations through E-Mail, Skype, screen sharing, and other forms of remote access.

positions.title: Woven Department Lead
positions.description: At Major Wire we have two departments: woven and FlexMat. Being the team lead, I am responsible for the safe, on-time production of mining screens and mining screen accessories through proper methods of shearing, hooking, welding, plasma cutting, and forklift driving. As well, I handle tasks related to shipping and receiving, quality control management and department maintenance/troubleshooting.

positions.title: Production Technician
positions.description:
I work closely on a daily basis with my department lead, where we manage all tasks for one half of our factory. I have immensely developed my analytical/problem solving skills in this work environment.

As well, I safely calibrate and utilize over half of the machines in our factory on a daily basis. I have begun learning basic mechanical and program troubleshooting techniques on these machines, as well as developed an understanding of adjusting pneumatic and hydraulic systems to achieve desired results.

positions.title: Morale/Intra-Fraternal Relations Chair Founder
positions.description:
Early in my junior year at WSU, I was informed of a traumatic incident that moved me to take action. A member of my fraternity was going through rough times, and a few too many jokes lead him to the top of our building, contemplating the worst. I saw an opportunity to take action against a lack of consideration and compassion for our fellow members. 

I pioneered a position, the Intra-Fraternal Relations Chair, that was responsible for maintaining a high level of conscientiousness and brotherhood between myself and my fellow fraternity brothers. The responsibilities and activities of the chair included:
- Counseling & conflict resolution for over 100 members
- Weekly summaries of weak points within the fraternity, followed by inspirational quotes
- Development of brotherhood/relations building activities

The chair has since evolved in name and function, and is to this day an integral part of the fraternity under the Brotherhood & Morale Chair positions
